name: Maasvlakte 2, Rotterdam (BRO)
description: 100 geotechnical boreholes of the Port of Rotterdam on Maasvlakte 2, 2017–2024, from the Dutch Key Register of the Subsurface (BRO), with their groundwater levels and 3188 laboratory test results. Land reclaimed in 2008–2013 from the North Sea: sand fill and sea-bed sand over the basal Holocene clay and peat, on Pleistocene sand and gravel. The units are an interpretation of each described log as a sequence (scripts/make-rotterdam-site.ts), with the paving of the quays in the sand; the logs keep the BRO soil names. Boreholes in the harbour basins start at its bed, 17–21 m below NAP. Heights in metres NAP.
source: BRO, Basisregistratie Ondergrond: geotechnical borehole research (BHR-GT), public domain (CC0)
